name: メンバー管理表の列見出し
prompt:

Original full image1/crop image2 PRIMARY for layout proportions, sorting-arrow shape/stroke/optical weight, spacing and fine detail; image3 mock SECONDARY Japanese wording. Source gray is a modal scrim over underlying table, not header fill; render header and outer canvas pure WHITE.
Five labels on one very wide compact row: left「名前」with original thin DOWNWARD arrow immediately beside it; distant right columns「役割」「参加日」「チーム」「最終利用」. Preserve original relative x positions/column ratios: name at0%, role about69%, joined77%, teams85%, last seen93%. Original thin neutral baseline, if visible. No rows, avatars, title, checkbox, menu or new icon.
Meiryo Regular14/24, tracking0, quiet gray/slate text and sort arrow #526173, no bold type, new accent or selected pill. Keep source descending sort state and all five headers. Crisp readable flat UI export, calm compact hierarchy, no enclosing card, shadow or broad tint.
